name: What are the key differences between a custom home and a production home?

mainEntity.name: What are the key differences between a custom home and a production home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom home is uniquely designed and built to your specific preferences, architectural style, and site characteristics. You have extensive control over the layout, materials, and finishes. In contrast, a production home is built from a pre-designed plan within a community, offering limited customization options. Custom homes typically involve a more personalized builder-client relationship and often result in a residence that perfectly fits your lifestyle and needs, though they generally require a longer timeline and higher cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom homes are uniquely designed to your specifications, offering full control over materials and layout, unlike production homes which use pre-set plans with limited customization.
